# Build on Wavlake

Docs for an open protocol and signed requests, written for people and the coding agents they work with.

Coming soon.

## Sections

- [Quickstart](/quickstart/): Where a new developer starts. Coming soon.
- [Concepts](/concepts/): The ideas behind the open protocol and signed requests. Coming soon.
- [API reference](/api-reference/): The REST API, call by call. Coming soon.
- [Event reference](/event-reference/): Events on the open protocol. Coming soon.
- [Agents and MCP](/agents-and-mcp/): How a coding agent reads this site. Coming soon.
- [Changelog](/changelog/): What changed on this site. Coming soon.

## For coding agents

- [/llms.txt](/llms.txt): A list of every page
- [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): Every page in one file
- [/pages.json](/pages.json): Every page and heading, as data
- [/quickstart.md](/quickstart.md): Any page, with .md on the end

This site is made to be read by a coding agent as well as a person.
